# Setup & Dependencies

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readxl)
  library(here)
})

# Robust path resolver across VS Code, RStudio, and command-line execution
find_path <- function(...) {
  # 1. Try relative to here()
  p1 <- here::here(...)
  if (file.exists(p1) || dir.exists(p1)) return(p1)
  
  # 2. Try relative to here("analysis", ...)
  p2 <- here::here("analysis", ...)
  if (file.exists(p2) || dir.exists(p2)) return(p2)
  
  # 3. Try from current working directory
  p3 <- file.path(...)
  if (file.exists(p3) || dir.exists(p3)) return(p3)
  
  # 4. Try one level up
  p4 <- file.path("..", ...)
  if (file.exists(p4) || dir.exists(p4)) return(p4)
  
  return(p1)
}
```

# Raw Data Ingestion

```{r load-raw-data}
# 1. Load raw oTree session wide exports
s1_path <- find_path("data", "raw", "raw_s1_all_apps_wide_2026-06-09-2.csv")
s2_path <- find_path("data", "raw", "raw_s2_all_apps_wide-2026-06-09-2.csv")

df_raw_s1 <- read.csv(s1_path, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
df_raw_s2 <- read.csv(s2_path, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))

# Combine oTree sessions
df_wide_raw <- bind_rows(df_raw_s1, df_raw_s2)

# Filter out demo sessions
df_wide <- df_wide_raw %>%
  filter(session.is_demo == 0) %>%
  mutate(pct_complete = rowMeans(!is.na(.)) * 100)

# Add session number and seat number for joining with questionnaire
df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  mutate(
    session_num = case_when(
      session.code == "ahosr93r" ~ 1L,
      session.code == "tdmddbpq" ~ 2L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    seat_num = activism.1.player.seat_number
  )
```

# Questionnaire & Demographics Ingestion

```{r load-questionnaire}
quest_path <- find_path("data", "raw", "Questionnaire.xlsx")

# Load session questionnaire sheets (handling various NA strings)
q_s1 <- readxl::read_excel(quest_path, sheet = "Session1", na = c("", "NA", "-NA-"))
q_s2 <- readxl::read_excel(quest_path, sheet = "Session2", na = c("", "NA", "-NA-"))

# Harmonize column types before merging
q_s1 <- q_s1 %>% mutate(
  Political_Orientation_0_10    = as.numeric(Political_Orientation_0_10),
  General_Trust_0_10            = as.numeric(General_Trust_0_10),
  Risk_Willingness_0_10         = as.numeric(Risk_Willingness_0_10),
  Monthly_Disposable_Income_EUR = as.character(Monthly_Disposable_Income_EUR)
)

q_s2 <- q_s2 %>% mutate(
  Political_Orientation_0_10    = as.numeric(Political_Orientation_0_10),
  General_Trust_0_10            = as.numeric(General_Trust_0_10),
  Risk_Willingness_0_10         = as.numeric(Risk_Willingness_0_10),
  Monthly_Disposable_Income_EUR = as.character(Monthly_Disposable_Income_EUR)
)

df_demographics <- bind_rows(q_s1, q_s2) %>%
  rename(
    session_num = Session,
    seat_num    = Booth_Number
  )

# Merge questionnaire demographics into df_wide
df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  left_join(df_demographics, by = c("session_num", "seat_num"))

# Clean subset (participants who completed the study through post-experimental questionnaire)
df_clean <- df_wide %>%
  filter(!is.na(questionnaire.1.player.q3_personal_cost))
```

# Reshape to Panel (Long Format)

```{r pivot-longer}
df_long <- df_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols          = matches("^activism\\.\\d+\\."),
    names_to      = c("app_round", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "activism\\.(\\d+)\\.(.*)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(app_round = as.integer(app_round))
```

# Variable Transformation & Feature Engineering

```{r recode-variables}
df_long <- df_long %>%
  rename(
    session_code       = session.code,
    participant_id     = participant.id_in_session,
    treatment_assigned = participant.treatment,
    final_payoff       = participant.payoff,
    selected_round     = participant.selected_round,
    id_in_group        = `player.id_in_group`,
    
    # Round-level variables
    wage               = `player.wage`,
    contribution       = `player.contribution`,
    round_payoff       = `player.round_payoff`,
    effort_score       = `player.effort_score`,
    actual_effort_time = `player.actual_effort_time`,
    group_raw_id       = `group.id_in_subsession`,
    num_activists      = `group.num_activists`,
    num_roadblockers   = `group.num_roadblockers`,
    round_treatment    = `group.treatment`,
    period             = `subsession.round_number`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    app_round_2        = if_else(app_round > 7, app_round - 7, app_round),
    group_id           = paste(session_code, group_raw_id, sep = "_"),
    participant_seat   = if_else(session_code == "ahosr93r",
                                 paste(participant.label, "1", sep = "_"),
                                 if_else(session_code == "tdmddbpq",
                                         paste(participant.label, "2", sep = "_"), "")),
    is_treatment_round = as.numeric(if_else(period <= 7, 0, 1)),
    condition          = if_else(is_treatment_round == 1, treatment_assigned, "control"),
    condition          = factor(condition, levels = c("control", "petition", "demonstration", "roadblock")),
    activism_rate      = if_else(is_treatment_round == 1, (num_activists / 4) * 100, NA_real_),
    chose_activism     = if_else(num_activists > 0, 1, 0),
    contribution       = as.numeric(contribution),
    wage               = as.numeric(wage),
    chose_activism     = as.numeric(chose_activism),
    round_payoff       = as.numeric(round_payoff),
    relative_contribution = if_else(!is.na(wage) & wage > 0, (contribution / wage) * 100, NA_real_),
    norm_wage          = wage / actual_effort_time,
    norm_payoff        = round_payoff / actual_effort_time,
    added_wage         = if_else(!is.na(wage) & wage > 0, round_payoff - wage, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  select(-(c(participant.visited:participant.mturk_assignment_id,
             session.label:session.treatment,
             player.role, questionnaire.1.player.role,
             group.total_contribution, player.payoff)))
```

# Peer Effects, Group Deviations & Lags

```{r compute-group-stats}
df_long <- df_long %>%
  group_by(group_id, period) %>%
  mutate(
    group_mean_contribution  = mean(contribution, na.rm = TRUE),
    group_total_contribution = if_else(is.na(contribution), NA_real_, sum(contribution, na.rm = TRUE)),
    group_size               = if_else(is.na(contribution), NA_integer_, sum(!is.na(contribution))),
    others_contribution      = if_else(group_size > 1 & !is.na(contribution),
                                       ((group_mean_contribution * group_size) - contribution) / (group_size - 1), NA_real_),
    total_wage               = if_else(is.na(wage), NA_real_, sum(wage, na.rm = TRUE)),
    welfare                  = if_else(is.na(round_payoff), NA_real_, sum(round_payoff, na.rm = TRUE)),
    norm_welfare             = if_else(is.na(round_payoff), NA_real_, sum(round_payoff, na.rm = TRUE) / actual_effort_time),
    welfare_fullcoop         = if_else(is.na(round_payoff), NA_real_, sum(wage, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.6),
    n_activists              = if_else(is.na(round_payoff), NA_real_, sum(num_activists, na.rm = TRUE)),
    n_freeriders             = if_else(is.na(contribution), NA_integer_, sum(contribution == 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
    efficiency               = if_else(!is.na(round_payoff), (welfare / welfare_fullcoop) * 100, NA_real_),
    NegDev                   = pmax(0, group_mean_contribution - contribution, na.rm = FALSE),
    PosDev                   = pmax(0, contribution - group_mean_contribution, na.rm = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(participant.code, period) %>%
  group_by(participant.code) %>%
  mutate(
    others_contribution_lag = lag(others_contribution),
    NegDev_lag              = if_else(period >= 8, lag(NegDev), NA_real_),
    PosDev_lag              = if_else(period >= 8, lag(PosDev), NA_real_),
    NegDev_lag_full         = lag(NegDev),
    PosDev_lag_full         = lag(PosDev)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(group_size == 4)

df_long_clean <- df_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(questionnaire.1.player.q3_personal_cost))
```

# Participant Summaries

```{r participant-summary}
df_questionnaire <- df_wide %>%
  select(session.code, participant.id_in_session, participant.treatment,
         matches("^questionnaire\\.1\\.player"),
         Age_Years, Nationality, Gender, Field_of_Study, Year_of_Study_Semester,
         Degree_Programme, Work_Experience, Highest_Education_Level, Employment,
         Monthly_Disposable_Income_EUR, Political_Orientation_0_10, General_Trust_0_10,
         Risk_Willingness_0_10, Charitable_Donations) %>%
  rename(session_code   = session.code,
         participant_id = participant.id_in_session) %>%
  mutate(participant.code = paste(session_code, participant_id, sep = "_"))

df_participant <- df_long %>%
  group_by(participant.code, group_id, session_code, treatment_assigned, condition, is_treatment_round) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_relative_contribution  = mean(relative_contribution, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_control_contribution   = mean(relative_contribution[period <= 7], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_treatment_contribution = mean(relative_contribution[period > 7], na.rm = TRUE),
    final_relative_contribution = last(relative_contribution[!is.na(relative_contribution)]),
    mean_num_activism           = mean(num_activists, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_payoff                 = mean(round_payoff, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(df_questionnaire, by = "participant.code")
```

# Export Processed Data

```{r export-clean-data}
# Determine processed directory path
raw_dir <- dirname(find_path("data", "raw", "Questionnaire.xlsx"))
proc_dir <- file.path(dirname(raw_dir), "processed")
if (!dir.exists(proc_dir)) dir.create(proc_dir, recursive = TRUE)

save(df_wide, df_clean,
     df_long, df_long_clean,
     df_participant, df_questionnaire,
     file = file.path(proc_dir, "clean_dfs.RData"))

write.csv(df_long, file.path(proc_dir, "df_long.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(df_wide, file.path(proc_dir, "df_wide.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("Data cleaning and merging completed successfully.\n")
cat("Outputs saved to:\n  -", file.path(proc_dir, "clean_dfs.RData"),
    "\n  -", file.path(proc_dir, "df_long.csv"),
    "\n  -", file.path(proc_dir, "df_wide.csv"), "\n")
```
